argumentOutline.thesis: Agreement is not proof that an arrangement is fair.
argumentOutline.cultural_rule: Keeping an exchange pleasant is treated as more important than naming who keeps adjusting.
argumentOutline.transit_job: Show which side keeps giving up time, money, effort, or a stated preference to keep the connection easy.
argumentOutline.failure_mechanism: A clear preference is withheld to avoid friction, so the choice defaults to the first or strongest answer.
argumentOutline.lived_scene_1: A shared decision where one side waits for every other preference before naming its own.
argumentOutline.lived_scene_2: A shared cost or workload that looks even until the exact amounts and follow-up work are named.
argumentOutline.lived_scene_3: A collaboration or friendship gets stronger or ends after both sides give an honest answer.
argumentOutline.strategy: State the preference, limit, and unequal cost early enough for the other side to respond to the truth.
argumentOutline.intended_close: A connection that requires one side to keep yielding was never balanced by agreement alone.
argumentOutline.scope_guard: Do not make romance, dinner planning, scheduling, or Libra's associated seventh house the whole article.

spine.effect: The argument may be reviewed, but drafting remains fail-closed until this family has an owner-recorded spine.
